title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode17 A Blue View

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! Everything looks perfect! Miku, let's have another day full of shows♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Hm? Isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, Minori! You came to see us!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry for just showing up like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is everything all right, Minori?
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not sure what to do anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you tell us about it? We'd love to help if we can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! You can talk to us about anything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku... Rin...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've had terrible luck ever since I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It would rain on days I was supposed to go on field trips, or birds would poop on me when I was wearing my favorite clothes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So many little things would always get me down. There was even a time when it was so bad I couldn't go to school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that's when I saw Haruka on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Her singing and dancing were so good that I could barely believe we were the same age. Before I realized it, I couldn't take my eyes off her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then she said something after she finished singing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She said she would give everyone the hope to believe in a better tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was so moved by those words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started believing that the good days would always come eventually, no matter how bad today was.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started wanting to be just like Haruka so I could give others hope the way she does.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I may have failed every single audition I went to, but I still enjoyed chasing after Haruka each and every day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it was Haruka that brightened your days and gave you hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm the person I am today because of her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Haruka has been suffering this whole time. She's been worried she can't bring others hope anymore, and has become too afraid to get on stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She gave up being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to encourage her, since she's the one who gave me hope, 
but I have no idea how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
.....
Haruka is really important to you, isn't she?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's why you're so worried about her.
You're such a kind person, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, how would you like to watch another of our shows? I'll prepare a special seat just for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? A s-special seat?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: C'mon, follow us♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! So this is what it's like to be backstage!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why is there a seat at the edge of the stage?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is your seat, Minori!
C'mon, Miku! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Y-You want me to watch the show from here?!
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! A very special friend has come to watch our show today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So we'd like her to enjoy the show from a very special seat!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We hope you enjoy the show, Minori!
All right, time to get started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and Rin's shows really are fantastic. I can feel myself being revitalized.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And now it's time for our next song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Everyone's glow sticks turned blue!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's so beautiful.
It really does look like an ocean from up here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So this is what Haruka always saw.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're back, Minori!
How was the show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was amazing! You two were so perfectly in sync! And it was wonderful seeing the view Haruka used to see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. The blue ocean of glow sticks really is beautiful from up here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The glow sticks sometimes all turn blue like that when we do shows in this world.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they did that the last time I was here too. But why?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure. This world is created from feelings, though. Perhaps it's a representation of someone's emotions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone's emotions?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All those happy, smiling faces bathed in a cool, blue light. It was so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I won't ever see it again, though...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Could it be Haruka's?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it really is Haruka's emotions, does that mean she still wants to see that ocean of blue?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if that's true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whenever I try to get on a stage now, my legs won't move.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it doesn't matter anymore. I accepted my shortcomings and decided to give up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's... That's so sad!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For her to never again look out on the view she most wants to see!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But maybe there is still something I can do for Haruka.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku! Rin! Would it be okay for me to bring Haruka up on stage?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to show her those lights!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If she can't be an idol again, then at the very least I want her to see her favorite view once more!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure! Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll bring Haruka, so please do another show when she gets here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I wonder if it might be better for you to put on the show instead of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! M-Me do a show?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! I think it would be better for you to convey your desire to cheer Haruka up yourself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've never performed on stage before.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't worry! Haruka is really important to you, right? I'm sure you'll do just great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No matter what was going on in my life, Haruka would always give me hope from up on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This time, it's my turn to do the same thing!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll do my best! I'll show Haruka what she wants to see most!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is one of ASRUN's songs.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot. I know I can't go back.
